name: Wet & Salty Adventure Sailing School
summary: Wet & Salty is a sailing school at Shallow Draught Marina in Bridgetown. It teaches American Sailing Association courses as day classes or liveaboard trips, and American Boating powerboat courses. It also runs skippered private day sails on a J/24, a Jeanneau 32i, a Prout Snowgoose 37 catamaran and a Dart 16 beach catamaran.
standouts: Lead instructor Captain Peter Hoad has over 40 years of sailing experience
Avoids single-use plastics and sails rather than motors whenever possible
Runs Blue Pathways, a sponsored sailing programme for young Barbadians aged 16 to 25

contact.address: Wet & Salty Adventure Sailing School, Shallow Draught Marina, Bridgetown

trips.title: ASA 101 Basic Keelboat Sailing
trips.summary: A three-day beginner course on a J/24 keelboat covering sailing terms, sail handling and safety. You sail by day and sleep at your hotel or home. Pass the exam and you earn the ASA 101 certification.
includes: Full-day, instructor-led sailing on a certified training vessel
All course materials and required ASA exams
trips.requirements: No sailing experience needed, but pre-study of the Sailing Made Easy textbook is required.
trips.checkNotes: Currency not stated, shown as $. Charter prices elsewhere on the site are in USD. Meeting point not stated for courses; the school's address is Shallow Draught Marina, Bridgetown. Booking page content loads by script and could not be read.

trips.title: ASA 103 Coastal Cruising
trips.summary: A three-day course on a Jeanneau 32 covering coastal navigation, anchoring, docking and reading the weather. It builds on ASA 101 and prepares you for longer coastal passages.
includes: Full-day, instructor-led sailing on a certified training vessel
All course materials and required ASA exams
trips.requirements: ASA 101 certification and review of the Coastal Cruising Made Easy textbook.
trips.checkNotes: Currency not stated, shown as $. Meeting point not stated for courses; the school's address is Shallow Draught Marina, Bridgetown.

trips.title: ASA 110 Small Boat Sailing
trips.summary: A three-day course on small centreboard boats or beach catamarans such as the GP14 or Dart 16. It focuses on quick, responsive boat handling and suits beginners as well as sailors with some experience.
includes: Full-day, instructor-led sailing on a certified training vessel
All course materials and required ASA exams
trips.requirements: None; suitable for beginners and those with some sailing experience.
trips.checkNotes: Currency not stated, shown as $. Daily hours not stated for this course. The Dart 16 beach catamaran experience starts at the Barbados Cruising Club; the course page does not say where this course meets.

trips.title: ASA 114 Catamaran Cruising
trips.summary: A private three-day course in handling a cruising catamaran, its systems and safety procedures. It runs on an Aventura 37 in high season and a Prout Snowgoose 37 the rest of the year.
highlights: Private class for up to 4 people
Aventura 37 (December to March) or Prout Snowgoose 37

trips.title: Beginner to Skipper
trips.summary: A nine-day liveaboard course on a Jeanneau Sun Odyssey 32i that takes complete beginners through ASA 101, 103 and 104. You practise tacking, reefing, man overboard drills, anchoring and skippering, with night anchoring and a last evening in Oistins.
trips.requirements: No prior sailing experience required, but pre-reading of the ASA textbooks is a must.
trips.checkNotes: No price on the course page; the booking page content loads by script and could not be read. Instructor gratuity not included.

trips.title: Learn to Cruise
trips.summary: A six-day, five-night liveaboard course on a Jeanneau Sun Odyssey 32i for ASA 101 graduates. You learn docking, anchoring, reefing, coastal navigation and passage planning, taking turns as skipper and mate.
trips.checkNotes: No price on the course page; the booking page content loads by script and could not be read. Instructor gratuity not included.

trips.title: Catamaran Learn to Cruise
trips.summary: A seven-day, six-night liveaboard course on an Aventura 37 cruising catamaran for ASA 101 graduates. You learn to dock and handle a twin-engine catamaran, anchor, navigate and plan passages, and leave with three ASA certifications.
trips.checkNotes: No price on the course page; the booking page content loads by script and could not be read. The day course page says the Aventura 37 is chartered for high season (December to March); the liveaboard page gives no dates. Instructor gratuity not included.

trips.title: Sailing Vacation & Mile building Experience
trips.summary: Six days and five nights on a Jeanneau Sun Odyssey 32i to log over 100 nautical miles with hands-on skippering, passage planning, night sailing and watchkeeping. There is no formal certification, but you leave with a signed mile logbook.
trips.requirements: Aimed at recent ASA 101, 103 or 104 graduates.
trips.checkNotes: No price on the page. The page does not list what is included beyond the logbook; the general liveaboard includes list (instruction, accommodation, meals except 2 to 3 onshore dinners) may apply.

trips.title: AB 101 Beginner Powerboating
trips.summary: A two-day American Boating course on a 12-foot centre console Highfield dinghy covering boat handling, docking, navigation and safety. It needs no boating experience and leads to the AB 101 certification.
includes: Full-day instructor-led training on a powerboat
American Boating certification upon passing the required assessments
trips.requirements: No boating experience needed, but pre-study of the Powerboating Made Easy textbook is required.
trips.checkNotes: Currency not stated, shown as $. Meeting point not stated.

trips.title: AB 103 Intermediate Powerboating
trips.summary: A three-day private course for cruising on powerboats of 30 to 45 feet, covering boat systems, close-quarters handling, weather and emergencies. It runs on request as a day course or a liveaboard course.
trips.requirements: AB 101 certification and review of the Advanced Powerboating textbook.
trips.checkNotes: Price and availability by email to info@wetandsaltysailing.com.

trips.title: AB 104 Advanced Powerboating
trips.summary: A three-day private course for skippering a 30 to 45 foot powerboat on multi-day trips in moderate to heavy conditions, covering provisioning, advanced navigation, multiple-anchor mooring and emergencies.
trips.requirements: AB 101 and AB 103 certification and review of the Advanced Powerboating textbook.
trips.checkNotes: Price and availability by email to info@wetandsaltysailing.com.

trips.title: Day Sail on a J/24
trips.summary: A private half-day sail on a J/24 racing keelboat with an ASA instructor as skipper. It is fast and hands-on, so you help trim, steer and move around the boat.
highlights: Snorkelling gear and soft drinks included
includes: Safety gear and basic sailing instruction
bring: Light lunch or snacks (unless lunch is pre-arranged)
trips.checkNotes: Price is per private charter, so priceFrom is null. Lunch can be added at extra cost. The weather FAQ says the departure point may change with sea conditions.

trips.summary: A private six-hour sail on the Prout Snowgoose 37 catamaran from Port St Charles, with time to lounge on the netting, swim with turtles and snorkel. It suits groups and celebrations.

trips.title: Beach catamaran sailing experience
trips.summary: A two-hour, hands-on sail on a Dart 16 beach catamaran in Carlisle Bay, starting from the Barbados Cruising Club beach. It is quick and lively, for up to two guests with an instructor.
includes: Safety gear and basic sailing instruction

offers.text: Wet & Salty Sailing Club: weekly sailing sessions on Saturday mornings and Sunday afternoons for BBD $500 per month, with J/24 private charters for members at BBD $250
offers.conditions: Minimum commitment of 3 months; membership can be paused for up to 2 months once a year. Advance booking required, limited crew spots per session. Based at Shallow Draught.

checkNotes: Booking is through four Book pages on the site (day courses, liveaboard courses, American Boating, private charters). Their booking content loads by script and could not be read, so it is not confirmed whether payment is taken online; WhatsApp, phone and email are also offered. Course prices show only $ (recorded as USD); charter prices say USD; Sailing Club prices say BBD. Liveaboard course prices are not shown on any page read. The News page had no readable text. Trading: copyright 2025, photos dated October 2025 on the charters page, and new Sailing Club and Blue Pathways pages. The operator list says it is also sold on Viator and TripAdvisor; not recorded.
